description: The same damaged outcome with the waiting state kept by id but moved: the edit gathers awaiting_return and overdue under a new compound state checked_out. Each of the two can be active and now has another parent, so the pair is breaking, the two parent changes reported before the added checked_out and the three additions the damaged outcome makes. A loan waits in awaiting_return with its due-date timer handed to the host, and at that position the predicate answers false: the active state's parent differs, and awaiting_return without checked_out is not a legal configuration of the new chart.
